description: Return a payment page for a self-serve plan, for the account the API key belongs to. Send the link to the account's owner: it asks them to sign in, or sign up with the account's email, before paying. A paid plan includes production keys, which the owner creates at https://app.arche.fi/keys. An account that already subscribes is refused and changes plan in the dashboard. Errors that a paid plan would lift name this tool's endpoint in details.checkout_link_endpoint.

plan.description: Plan the owner would buy. Developer covers every company Arche serves.
